findings: F1 fresh-home watcher defect (FAIL -> fixed): ensureRpcDir only mkdir'd the leaf; on a brand-new workspace the base did not exist, ENOENT was swallowed by the silent plugin-init catch, and EVERY intel_read returned RPC_TIMEOUT. Fix: recursive base mkdir + a loud warn instead of a silent catch. Verified on a fresh base and after deleting the whole home.

F2 bare shadow ids not reachable live (FAIL -> fixed): the bare `grep`/`lsp` ids did not reach the model on MiMo 0.1.14 (builtin grammar observed; `lsp` absent from the model's list) while the plugin registered both correctly. Fix: additive mimo_grep / mimo_lsp registered alongside, gated behind opts.shadow.

F3 js re-entry broken live, ST blind (FAIL -> fixed): the vm context had no require and no crypto, so the JS stub died with a raw TypeError; the ST row only asserted the preamble TEXT contains RPC_TIMEOUT. Fix: driver seeds createRequire + randomBytes + globalThis; the stub now throws the NAMED RPC_CJS_ONLY when the bridge is absent.
F4 S17-class gap closed: the ttsr/advisor reminder path was structurally unobservable; the receipt sink makes it L2-observable (opt-in, off by default).
